text:
Sam (AE): Hey team, customer just added a bunch of new asks mid-pilot — wants streaming summarization + rerank + BYO-KMS for keys, and they now require private network egress (VPC only). Can we still hit the original timeline?
Miguel (SRE): that's a heavy change. BYO-KMS + private egress means Private deployment or Dedicated with network peering. Latency and cost will change. p95 will jump if we do on-call KMS per-token.
Caroline (Eng): FYI BYO-KMS per-token RSA unwrap on each request will add ~40-80ms depending on region. If they want streaming w/ low-latency p50 we need in-proc key cache or kms-proxy.
Tina (Solutions): Can we scope an interim: hosted API + kms-proxy in customer's VPC to avoid full private deploy? That would require a consented network route and infra work from their side.
Sam (AE): They explicitly said "no shared hosts" and need audit logs in our control plane. They're skeptical of proxies. :grimacing: 
Elaine (Sales Ops): Also they want SLA on end-to-end 200ms p95 for summarization. That feels impossible over remote KMS.
Miguel (SRE): 200ms p95 with BYO-KMS + rerank is unrealistic unless we do local key cache + Dedicated GPUs in-region. Need numbers: qps, avg tokens, max seq len.
Sam (AE): qps ~15 reqs/s, burst to 50. avg seq len 120 tokens, rerank ~8 documents per query. Budget is tight — they pushed back on our Dedicated numbers earlier.
Caroline (Eng): rough back-of-envelope: Hosted w/ kms-proxy = extra 60-100ms, Dedicated w/ cached keys = baseline + 10-30ms. Quantized model helps cost but not KMS overhead.
Tina (Solutions): Proposal to customer: 2-stage pilot
- Stage A (2 weeks): Hosted + sim BYO-KMS via opaque signing (we sign tokens periodically) to validate quality and prompts/evals
- Stage B (3 weeks): Dedicated capacity + key-cache deployed into their VPC for latency SLOs and audit logs
We can provide temporary cost numbers for each stage.
Sam (AE): They want timeline in writing. Also security will ask for design diagram and attestation re: key access.
security-bot: Please attach completed security questionnaire (SSQ) and network diagram. See https://redwood.ai/sg/ssq
Tina (Solutions): I'll draft the security diagram and flow. Need decision on whether we can support HSM-derived keys or only KMS API.
Miguel (SRE): We can support customer-managed keys if they expose a standard KMS API reachable from our dedicated nodes. HSM on-prem requiring hardware crypto modules in their DC is a full Private deployment feature.
Sam (AE): Pricing ask — how much uplift for Dedicated + key-cache vs Hosted? Need a short diff to justify to procurement.
Caroline (Eng): Quick numbers to use in negotiation (estimates):
- Hosted baseline (current POC): $X/day
- Hosted + kms-proxy: +30-40% (network + infra) -> $X*1.35/day
- Dedicated w/ key-cache (meets 200ms p95): +200-250% vs baseline -> $X*3.0/day
Include one-time infra work: ~3 engineer-weeks for network peering + security attestation.
Sam (AE): put those in a one-pager. Also they requested we run evals on their prompt set (2000 prompts) and provide regression alerting if quality drops after quantization.
Tina (Solutions): We'll run the evals in Stage A — need to confirm data handling (sandbox, retention). Also propose pass/fail criteria: rerank NDCG@10 >= 0.72 and summarization ROUGE-L > 0.45 on their test set.
Elaine (Sales Ops): Timeline note: procurement needs cost + SOC2 attestation to sign. They said legal review is 2 weeks after we hand over security docs.
Miguel (SRE): Action items:
- @Caroline: perf delta matrix for the 3 config options (today + 48h)
- @Tina: draft Stage A/B plan + eval criteria (tomorrow noon)
- @Sam: confirm QPS and sample data upload ETA (EOD)
- @Elaine: prep security docs + SSQ stub (48h)
Caroline (Eng): I'll include sample perf numbers by region (us-west/us-east/eu) and impact of key-cache TTL settings.
Sam (AE): customer follow-up: they asked if we can do a partial rollback to compressed model if latency/price high. We should include fallback policy in proposal.
Tina (Solutions): include rollout plan: canary -> 50% -> full; auto-fallback to smaller model or cached embeddings for rerank if p95 > threshold.
Sam (AE): will take to customer tomorrow. Please add any risks we should call out.
Miguel (SRE): Risks: network egress complexity, BYO-KMS SLA mismatch, audit log completeness, data residency compliance depending on region.
Tina (Solutions): Also risk: prompt drift during Stage A causing noisy evals; recommend a small seed set of golden prompts for health checks.
Sam (AE): thanks — let's keep updates here. I'll post customer reaction after the call. :thumbsup:
